lib='''"""Reusable helpers for ARC separator-block tasks."""

from collections import Counter


def find_separator(grid):
    """Return the color that forms complete uniform rows AND columns in the grid (the divider color)."""
    full_rows = {row[0] for row in grid if len(set(row)) == 1}
    for c in full_rows:
        if all(all(row[j] == c for row in grid) for j in range(len(grid[0])) if True) and \\
           any(all(row[j] == c for row in grid) for j in range(len(grid[0]))):
            return c
    return None


def split_counts(grid, sep):
    """Return (row_ranges, col_ranges) of the blocks between full separator lines."""
    rows = [i for i, r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r)) == 1 and r[0] == sep]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(r[j] == sep for r in grid)]
    def ranges(idx, n):
        out, start = [], 0
        for i in idx:
            if i > start:
                out.append((start, i))
            start = i + 1
        if start < n:
            out.append((start, n))
        return out
    return ranges(rows, len(grid)), ranges(cols, len(grid[0]))


def block_mark_grid(grid):
    """Split grid on separator lines; per block return (bg, mark_count) where bg is the majority non-separator color and marks are the rest."""
    sep = find_separator(grid)
    rr, cc = split_counts(grid, sep)
    bg = Counter(v for r in grid for v in r if v != sep).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for (r0, r1) in rr:
        row = []
        for (c0, c1) in cc:
            marks = sum(1 for i in range(r0, r1) for j in range(c0, c1)
                        if grid[i][j] != sep and grid[i][j] != bg)
            row.append((bg, marks))
        out.append(row)
    return out


def marks_threshold_grid(grid, threshold=2, hit=1):
    """Per separator-block: emit hit if the block has >= threshold minority-color cells, else the background color."""
    return [[hit if m >= threshold else bg for bg, m in row]
            for row in block_mark_grid(grid)]
